steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the range or disconnect power before servicing. Resistance checks require power off. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug range or disconnect power before resistance measurements.

steps.title: Control supply P1-1 to P1-3
steps.body: Connect meter. Restore power. Confirm 120 VAC at control P1-1 to P1-3 (or terminal block L1–N).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Connect meter. Restore power. Confirm 120 VAC at control P1-1 to P1-3 (or terminal block L1–N).

steps.title: Wiring between control and terminal block
steps.body: Power off. Check wires/connectors between control and terminal block — fully seated?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Check wires/connectors between control and terminal block — fully seated?

steps.title: Repair wiring
steps.body: Repair harness/terminal block, restore power, retest.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Repair harness/terminal block, restore power, retest.

steps.title: F9E0 terminal block wiring
steps.body: For F9E0: verify 240 VAC L1–L2 and 120 VAC L1–N and L2–N at supply; range terminal block wired correctly.
steps.sourceExcerpt: For F9E0: verify 240 VAC L1–L2 and 120 VAC L1–N and L2–N at supply; range terminal block wired correctly.

steps.title: Correct terminal block wiring
steps.body: Correct miswire per tech sheet, retest.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Correct miswire per tech sheet, retest.

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the range or disconnect power before servicing. Resistance checks require power off. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug range or disconnect power before resistance measurements.

steps.title: Bake element resistance
steps.body: Power off. LCX: P4-3 to P5-4; LCC: Con 2-7 to Con 4-3 — expect 10–40 Ω nominal.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. LCX: P4-3 to P5-4; LCC: Con 2-7 to Con 4-3 — expect 10–40 Ω nominal.

steps.title: Bake mode voltage
steps.body: In Bake mode verify 240 VAC at element when energized (may cycle with broil on some models).
steps.sourceExcerpt: In Bake mode verify 240 VAC at element when energized (may cycle with broil on some models).

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the range or disconnect power before servicing. Resistance checks require power off. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug range or disconnect power before resistance measurements.

steps.title: Broil element resistance
steps.body: Power off. LCX: P5-1 to P5-4 WH; LCC: Con 2-1 to Con 4-3 — expect 10–40 Ω nominal.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. LCX: P5-1 to P5-4 WH; LCC: Con 2-1 to Con 4-3 — expect 10–40 Ω nominal.

steps.title: Broil mode voltage
steps.body: In Broil mode only broil element energized — verify 240 VAC at element.
steps.sourceExcerpt: In Broil mode only broil element energized — verify 240 VAC at element.

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the range or disconnect power before servicing. Resistance checks require power off. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug range or disconnect power before resistance measurements.

steps.title: Clean keypad latch test in Diagnostics
steps.body: In Diagnostics press CLEAN to run lock motor. Follow F5E1 tree: latch icon vs door state.
steps.sourceExcerpt: In Diagnostics press CLEAN to run lock motor. Follow F5E1 tree: latch icon vs door state.

steps.title: Latch motor voltage P2-3 to N
steps.body: When latch should run (within 20 sec of CLEAN), verify 120 VAC at P2-3 to N (LCX).
steps.sourceExcerpt: When latch should run (within 20 sec of CLEAN), verify 120 VAC at P2-3 to N (LCX).

steps.title: Latch motor resistance
steps.body: Power off. LCX: P2-3 to P1-3 WH; LCC: Con 1-4 to Con 1-1 W — expect 500–3000 Ω.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. LCX: P2-3 to P1-3 WH; LCC: Con 1-4 to Con 1-1 W — expect 500–3000 Ω.

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the range or disconnect power before servicing. Resistance checks require power off. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug range or disconnect power before resistance measurements.

steps.title: DSI bake valve J1-1 to J1-2
steps.body: In Bake mode with burner operation attempted, measure valve coil — 216 Ω nominal at J1-1 to J1-2.

testPoint.label: DSI bake valve J1-1 to J1-2

measurements.title: DSI bake valve J1-1 to J1-2

steps.sourceExcerpt: In Bake mode with burner operation attempted, measure valve coil — 216 Ω nominal at J1-1 to J1-2.

steps.title: DSI broil valve J1-3 to J1-2
steps.body: In Broil mode measure J1-3 to J1-2 — 216 Ω nominal.

testPoint.label: DSI broil valve J1-3 to J1-2

measurements.title: DSI broil valve J1-3 to J1-2

steps.sourceExcerpt: In Broil mode measure J1-3 to J1-2 — 216 Ω nominal.

steps.title: DSI supply and flame sense
steps.body: Verify 120 VAC J1-4 to J1-6 (bake) and J1-4 to J1-10. When lit, flame sense 8–18 VDC.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify 120 VAC J1-4 to J1-6 (bake) and J1-4 to J1-10. When lit, flame sense 8–18 VDC.

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the range or disconnect power before servicing. Resistance checks require power off. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug range or disconnect power before resistance measurements.

steps.title: Keypad connector P11
steps.body: Power off. Inspect keypad connection to main control (P11). Reseat if loose.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Inspect keypad connection to main control (P11). Reseat if loose.

steps.title: Repair P11 harness
steps.body: Repair connector/harness, restore power, wait 60 sec.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Repair connector/harness, restore power, wait 60 sec.

steps.title: Retest after reconnect
steps.body: Does F2E1 clear after reconnect? If reappears, replace keypad then control.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Does F2E1 clear after reconnect? If reappears, replace keypad then control.

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the range or disconnect power before servicing. Resistance checks require power off. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug range or disconnect power before resistance measurements.

steps.title: Cooktop On indicator
steps.body: Turn any cooktop element ON — does Cooktop On indicator light?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Turn any cooktop element ON — does Cooktop On indicator light?

steps.title: Element cycles hot
steps.body: At high setting, does infinite switch cycle element on/off to maintain temperature?
steps.sourceExcerpt: At high setting, does infinite switch cycle element on/off to maintain temperature?

steps.title: Check infinite switch wiring
steps.body: Inspect switch terminals and supply to affected burner.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Inspect switch terminals and supply to affected burner.

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the range or disconnect power before servicing. Resistance checks require power off. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug range or disconnect power before resistance measurements.

steps.title: Confirm F3E0 / room temp in Diagnostics
steps.body: Enter Diagnostics (CANCEL×2+START). Verify sensor at room temp and failure code matches.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Enter Diagnostics (CANCEL×2+START). Verify sensor at room temp and failure code matches.

steps.title: Sensor harness connections
steps.body: Power off. Check sensor connections on harness and board (P3 or Con 3).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Check sensor connections on harness and board (P3 or Con 3).

steps.title: Repair sensor harness
steps.body: Repair harness, retest.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Repair harness, retest.

steps.title: RTD resistance at sensor connector
steps.body: Disconnect sensor. Measure pins — 1000–1200 Ω at room temp. LCX: P3-4 to P3-5; LCC: Con 3-9 to Con 3-10. Check short to casing.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect sensor. Measure pins — 1000–1200 Ω at room temp. LCX: P3-4 to P3-5; LCC: Con 3-9 to Con 3-10. Check short to casing.

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the range or disconnect power before servicing. Resistance checks require power off. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug range or disconnect power before resistance measurements.

steps.title: Surface burner spark test
steps.body: Turn one cooktop knob to LITE. Verify burner sparks. Expect 120 VAC L to N at spark module.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Turn one cooktop knob to LITE. Verify burner sparks. Expect 120 VAC L to N at spark module.
